questions.SQL: SELECT T1.fld035, T1.fld036 FROM tab08 AS T1 INNER JOIN tab02 AS T2 ON T1.fld042 = T2.fld008 WHERE T2.fld010 = 'School of Applied Sciences, Technology and Education'

questions.question: Calculate the amount budgeted for 'April Speaker' event. List all the budgeted categories for said event in an ascending order based on their amount budgeted.

questions.SQL_original: SELECT T2.category, SUM(T2.amount) FROM event AS T1 JOIN budget AS T2 ON T1.event_id = T2.link_to_event WHERE T1.event_name = 'April Speaker' GROUP BY T2.category ORDER BY SUM(T2.amount) ASC

questions.question: Calculate the difference of the total amount spent in all events by the Student_Club in year 2019 and 2020.
questions.evidence: The first 4 strings of the fld003 values in the event table can represent year; The difference of the total amount fld021 = SUBTRACT(fld021 where YEAR(fld003) = 2019, spent where YEAR(fld003) = 2020)
questions.SQL: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(T1.fld003, 1, 4) = '2019' THEN T2.fld021 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(T1.fld003, 1, 4) = '2020' THEN T2.fld021 ELSE 0 END) AS num FROM tab01 AS T1 INNER JOIN tab05 AS T2 ON T1.fld001 = T2.fld017
questions.SQL_original: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(T1.event_date, 1, 4) = '2019' THEN T2.spent ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(T1.event_date, 1, 4) = '2020' THEN T2.spent ELSE 0 END) AS num FROM event AS T1 INNER JOIN budget AS T2 ON T1.event_id = T2.link_to_event

questions.question: Based on the total cost for all event, what is the percentage of cost for Yearly Kickoff event?
questions.evidence: percentage = DIVIDE(SUM(fld028 where fld002 = 'Yearly Kickoff'), SUM(fld028)) * 100
questions.SQL: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.fld002 = 'Yearly Kickoff' THEN T3.fld028 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / SUM(T3.fld028) FROM tab01 AS T1 INNER JOIN tab05 AS T2 ON T1.fld001 = T2.fld017 INNER JOIN tab06 AS T3 ON T2.fld019 = T3.fld030
questions.SQL_original: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.event_name = 'Yearly Kickoff' THEN T3.cost ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / SUM(T3.cost) FROM event AS T1 INNER JOIN budget AS T2 ON T1.event_id = T2.link_to_event INNER JOIN expense AS T3 ON T2.budget_id = T3.link_to_budget

questions.question: Among the members with t-shirt size of medium, what is the percentage of the amount 50 received by the Student_Club?
questions.evidence: fld039 = 'Medium' where fld038 = 'Member'; percentage = DIVIDE(COUNT(fld023 = 50), COUNT(fld034)) * 100
questions.SQL: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T2.fld023 = 50 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T2.fld031) FROM tab08 AS T1 INNER JOIN tab07 AS T2 ON T1.fld034 = T2.fld018 WHERE T1.fld038 = 'Member' AND T1.fld039 = 'Medium'
questions.SQL_original: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T2.amount = 50 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T2.income_id) FROM member AS T1 INNER JOIN income AS T2 ON T1.member_id = T2.link_to_member WHERE T1.position = 'Member' AND T1.t_shirt_size = 'Medium'

questions.question: Among the events attended by more than 10 members of the Student_Club, how many of them are meetings?
questions.evidence: meetings events refers to fld004 = 'Meeting'; attended by more than 10 members refers to COUNT(fld001) > 10
questions.SQL: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.fld001) FROM tab01 AS T1 INNER JOIN tab04 AS T2 ON T1.fld001 = T2.fld017 WHERE T1.fld004 = 'Meeting' GROUP BY T1.fld001 HAVING COUNT(T2.fld017) > 10
questions.SQL_original: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.event_id) FROM event AS T1 INNER JOIN attendance AS T2 ON T1.event_id = T2.link_to_event WHERE T1.type = 'Meeting' GROUP BY T1.event_id HAVING COUNT(T2.link_to_event) > 10
